answer: One concrete defense is bonded staking anchored to a trust graph: each agent must post a refundable deposit to become a vertex, and existing peers must vouch for it before it can earn. A sybil swarm would then have to fund every fake vertex independently, so cloned identities merely echo one another's claims without gathering real attestations. On a trust map they surface as dim umber nodes, unstaked and unvouched, which makes mass fake-identity creation economically pointless.
